entries.name: Resolution Space Framework
entries.summary: Primary preserved source artifact defining the resolution research space from which the Anchor and RTP were derived.

entries.name: Anchor Foundational Space
entries.summary: Minimal relational substrate for Set Calculus resolution, built from relation, state, transition, admissibility, Klein interface, closure, provenance, and reconciliation.

provenance.note: Human-directed formalization derived from the Resolution Space Framework.

entries.name: Resolution Transition Problem
entries.summary: Finite decision problem asking whether an admissible provenance-preserving trajectory crosses the Klein region and terminates in reconciliation.

entries.name: Bounded canonical RTP is in NP
entries.summary: Under the canonical linear trajectory bound m <= N, RTP certificates have O(N^2) size and admit polynomial-time deterministic verification.

entries.name: 100 Monkeys Photonic Model NP-Complete Solution
entries.summary: Canonical provenance name for the 100 Monkeys research line from which the Resolution Space Framework, Anchor formalization, and RTP development were captured.
